confirmed: Melting Point cleans a capped random sample of physical detrimental effects and spends steam, without setting ignore_fireburn.
BURNING/BURNING_SHOCK are physical detrimental; existing instances can be selected. BURNING_HEX is magical and outside the filter.
Life in the Flames on_learn at raw5 sets ignore_fireburn; on_unlearn at raw4 removes it. Actor superload checks exactly BURNING/BURNING_SHOCK and sets p.dur=0.
ActorTemporaryEffects.setEffect checks p.dur after the superloaded callback at line132 and removes/does not add that effect. This completes the concrete contrast chain.
Molten Point activate/deactivate are empty. The located core callbackOnDispelled handles only WORM_ROT, a magical effect; it does not grant burning immunity.
